result.summary: The urban environment features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and sidewalks with tactile warning strips. However, visibility is compromised by a vehicle parked close to the crossing, and there are no visible pedestrian-specific signals at the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A silver SUV is parked very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, just past the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide safe crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sight lines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The street features a well-defined pedestrian environment with marked zebra crosswalks, dedicated signals, and wide sidewalks. The presence of a bike lane and street trees enhances the urban character, though some pavement degradation is visible in the roadway.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surface within the crosswalk area could cause trips or falls.

hazards.name: Shared Lane Conflict
hazards.description: The proximity of the bike lane to the travel lane without physical separation may lead to vehicle-cyclist conflicts near the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway where the cyclist is riding.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and increase their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the clarity of pavement markings.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and signalization. However, safety is compromised by poor pavement conditions in the roadway and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the crosswalk area creates a trip hazard for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corner block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and uneven roadway surface within the pedestrian crossing zone.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and wide sidewalks. The environment is primarily commercial and residential with high-rise buildings, featuring pedestrian signals and street lighting.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns into the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left and right corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of physical protection
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for the full width of the crossing without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
